It is not clear whether that means the boarding partner picks Milo up from the home address by 08:00, whether the time is flexible, or whether evening-before intake is possible. - DLP-002B ($1,095, bundle-crest) is within cap on paper, but the late-night pickup fee is unspecified and could affect real total cost. The 06:15 drop-off requirement is also tight enough that its flexibility matters.
